scope: Independent source/export geometry probe; browser acceptance is recorded separately
method: Unmodified GLTFLoader.parseAsync, AnimationMixer with LoopOnce and clampWhenFinished, scene.updateMatrixWorld(true), SkinnedMesh.getVertexPosition(i).applyMatrix4(mesh.matrixWorld), compare every exported vertex through sourceVertexByGltfVertex to Blender evaluated surface positions. Node image decode was stubbed; this does not verify textures or rendered appearance.
composition: Gait tracks exclude riderUpperBodyMask; rider-action tracks include it. Both play at the same explicit time, composing local tracks before hierarchy evaluation.

rebuild.method: Two separate factory-startup script runs produced byte-identical GLBs and landmark JSON; .blend files preserve authored source but are not byte-hash repeatability gates

independentCodeReview.finding: Claimed ancestor transform was applied twice to exported POSITION
independentCodeReview.disposition: Dismissed after actual GLTFLoader evaluation: attached SkinnedMesh.bindMatrixInverse compensates mesh.matrixWorld. The review's manually transformed coordinate omitted this factor.
